# Requirements Quality Checklist: Landing Page Artzen Ambientes Planejados

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation and unit tests for English specification completeness, clarity, and consistency.
**Created**: 2026-09-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Scope Alignment

- [x] CHK001 Are the removal of the Quick Lead Form and direct phone calls reflected consistently across all specification requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact visual tokens (colors, background images, and architectural textures) for the Light Luxury theme explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements documented for fallback states when external project images fail to load? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are all 6 room portfolio categories and their respective technical specs enumerated in detail? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK005 Is the primary conversion response threshold quantified with objective criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK006 Is the floating WhatsApp widget behavior (activation trigger, scroll persistence, dismissibility) specified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §US-1]
- [x] CHK007 Are Core Web Vitals targets (LCP < 2.0s, CLS < 0.05, INP < 100ms) specified with exact measurement conditions? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK008 Are touch target dimensions for mobile CTAs explicitly defined with standard minimums? [Clarity, Constitution §Principle III]

## Scenario Coverage & Edge Cases

- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for ultra-wide screen (> 2560px) layout constraints? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are reduced-motion accessibility requirements defined for interactive transitions and modal overlays? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution §Principle II]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements specified for offline or disabled JavaScript navigation fallback? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are URL encoding rules and Brazilian Portuguese pre-filled messages specified for each distinct environment quote trigger? [Coverage, Spec §US-2, Spec §FR-007]

## Technical SEO & Discoverability Requirements

- [x] CHK013 Are Schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD fields (opening hours, address, geographic coordinates, phone) completely documented in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 Are Open Graph and Twitter Card tags defined with exact title, description, and social banner image requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 Are canonical URL and robot indexing rules defined in specification requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
